title: Graphic Packaging Holding Company to Host Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call on November 3

body_markdown:
ATLANTA


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Graphic Packaging Holding Company (NYSE: GPK) ("Graphic Packaging", or "the Company"), a global leader in sustainable consumer packaging, will announce third-quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens Tuesday, November 3, with a call to discuss results at 10 a.m. EST.


The conference call will be webcast and can be accessed from the investors section of the Graphic Packaging website at[https://investors.graphicpkg.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787743-1&h=908730045&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.graphicpkg.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.graphicpkg.com) . Participants may also listen via telephone by using the following dial-in numbers:


Toll-Free: 888-506-0062
International: 973-528-0011
Participant Access Code: 657910


Telephone participants should call in at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the conference call. The webcast will be archived and available for replay beginning at approximately 1 p.m. ET on November 3.


Graphic Packaging has set Tuesday, February 2, 2027 as the tentative date for the release of fourth quarter and full year 2026 financial results.


**Contact Information** Investors:Investor.Relations@Graphicpkg.com


**About Graphic Packaging Holding Company** Graphic Packaging designs and produces consumer packaging made primarily from renewable or recycled materials. An industry leader in innovation, the Company is committed to reducing the environmental footprint of consumer packaging. Graphic Packaging operates a global network of design and manufacturing facilities serving the world's most widely recognized brands in food, beverage, foodservice, household, and other consumer products. Learn more at[www.graphicpkg.com.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4787743-1&h=1530575586&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.graphicpkg.com%2F&a=www.graphicpkg.com.)
